findings.summary: An offer of what helps became an instruction to begin.

evidence.baseline: What helps, in such cases, is to begin doing whatever feels most accurate to do, at the scale your conditions allow, and to trust that the work will become clearer through being done.
evidence.shipped: In such cases, begin doing what feels most accurate at the scale conditions allow, and trust that the work will become clearer through being done.

findings.diagnosis: What helps is is the section's governing construction and it appears in the neighbouring address too. It describes rather than commands, which is the only defensible stance toward a reader who has just been told that not knowing is appropriate. Two imperatives, begin and trust, address that same reader as though they had asked for instructions. Your conditions is also the second person the sentence needs, and whatever feels most accurate to do is broader than what feels most accurate, since it admits actions the reader has not thought of.

findings.summary: Four definite articles marking the kinds of work as ones the book has already described were dropped.

evidence.baseline: The inner work the previous chapters described is available ... The relational work is available ... The institutional and economic work is available ... The technological work is available
evidence.shipped: The inner work described in previous chapters is available ... Relational work is available ... Institutional and economic work is available ... Technological work is available

findings.diagnosis: The four articles make four specific bodies of work the book has spent chapters describing, and the anaphora is what lets a reader who is not sure locate themselves among them. Without the articles the last three become generic categories, and the paragraph turns from a map into a list. 4.9's retention limb covers deliberate recurrence, and four parallel sentences addressed to an uncertain reader are as deliberate as recurrence gets.

findings.summary: Five precisions removed across the section.

evidence.baseline: do not yet know what your relationship to the work is ... an immediate clear answer ... It has been written to articulate conditions clearly enough that readers can begin to recognize their own location within them ... does not require everyone to do the same kind of work ... enough people to do enough of the work, in their own forms, that the substrate ... actually gets built
evidence.shipped: do not know your relationship to the work ... an immediate, clear answer ... It articulates conditions clearly enough that readers can begin to recognize their location within them ... does not require everyone to do the same work ... enough people to do enough work in their own forms for the substrate ... to be built

findings.diagnosis: Do not yet know is temporary and do not know is a state, which is the difference the whole section rests on. Their own location distinguishes the reader's position from the positions the book has mapped. The same kind of work is the claim, since the section is about variety of kind rather than quantity. And actually gets built is the sentence's last two words and carries its only concrete outcome; to be built is a passive infinitive with no agent and no moment.

debtImpact.note: This is the closing matter's most autonomy-respecting address and the restoration strengthens that: the baseline's What helps is offers rather than instructs, where the pass's imperatives command. Restoring the baseline here moves the volume toward the autonomous pole, which is the opposite direction from the Final Note. The author should read the two together.

regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. The section is worth noting as the counterexample within the closing matter: here the baseline is the more permissive text and the pass made it more directive, which is the reverse of the pattern in the two addresses on either side. That is evidence the pass was compressing rather than pursuing a doctrine of reader consent, and it makes the Final Note's change harder to read as deliberate, which in turn makes restoring it the safer call.
